name: Filter — number in range
description: Branches pass / fail. Pass when the source number is within [min, max] (inclusive). Use the 'count' binding kind on source for 'if there are 2+ adults' patterns.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The number you want to test — pick a numeric field from the request, or use 'Count of' to count items in an array.

params.name: min
params.description: Lower bound. Omit for no lower bound.

params.name: max
params.description: Upper bound. Omit for no upper bound.

params.name: minInclusive
params.description: Treat min as inclusive (≥). Default true.

params.name: maxInclusive
params.description: Treat max as inclusive (≤). Default true.

params.name: round
params.description: Optional rounding applied to the source before the range check.

enum.label: Floor
enum.description: Round down to the nearest integer.

enum.label: Ceiling
enum.description: Round up to the nearest integer.

enum.label: Half-to-even
enum.description: Banker's rounding (closest integer; ties go to even).

params.name: arraySelector
params.description: When the source resolves to multiple numbers, which match decides pass/fail.

enum.label: Any match
enum.description: Pass if at least one element is in range.

enum.label: All match
enum.description: Pass only if every element is in range.

enum.label: None match
enum.description: Pass only when zero elements are in range.

enum.label: Only one
enum.description: Pass only when the array has exactly one element AND it's in range.

params.name: onMissing
params.description: What to do when the source path isn't in the request.

enum.label: Skip
enum.description: Stop this rule and move on without a verdict.
